title: Twin Bridges Half Marathon Muar 2026 Review: Johor's Dual-Bridge 21K
seo_title: Twin Bridges Half Marathon Muar 2026 Review | Johor Malaysia
meta_description: The Twin Bridges Half Marathon Muar 2026: October 25 at Dataran Tanjung Emas, Muar, Johor. A single-distance 21.1K across Muar's twin bridges — registration open.
dek: Set for 25 October 2026 at Dataran Tanjung Emas in Muar, Johor, this single-distance half marathon crosses Muar's iconic twin bridges. Registration open. A distinctive Johor road race over the Muar River.
verdict: The Twin Bridges Half Marathon Muar makes its course the star: a 21.1K route across Muar's two bridges spanning the Muar River, starting and finishing at Dataran Tanjung Emas — the town's waterfront esplanade. A single-distance format keeps it focused, and registration is open. Muar is Johor's royal town, known for its heritage architecture, its food scene (Muar otak-otak and mee bandung), and its laid-back riverside character. For runners wanting a distinctive Johor half marathon with a bridge-crossing course and open registration, this is worth a look.

sections.heading: The Twin Bridges
paragraphs: Muar's two bridges — the Sultan Ismail Bridge (the old bridge, opened 1967) and the Muar Second Bridge (the new bypass) — provide a distinctive tandem crossing of the Muar River. [1] Dataran Tanjung Emas is Muar's waterfront esplanade, a popular local running spot with river views and sea breezes.
